ingredients.name: Parma Ham & Parmigiano Reggiano Filled Pasta
ingredients.buy: Parma Ham & Parmigiano Reggiano Filled Pasta

points: Trim the courgette, then quarter lengthways. Chop into 1-2cm chunks.
Peel and grate the garlic (or use a garlic press).
steps.title: Get Prepped

points: Heat a drizzle of oil in a large frying pan on high heat.
When hot, add the courgette and cook until charred, 6-8 mins total. Turn only every couple of mins.
steps.title: Char the Courgette

points: Meanwhile, pour the boiled water into a large saucepan with 1/2 tsp salt and bring back to the boil.
Add the filled pasta and cook until tender, 3 mins.
Once cooked, carefully drain in a colander and return to the pan. Drizzle with oil and gently stir through to stop it sticking together.
steps.title: Pasta Time

points: When the courgette is charred, reduce the heat to medium. Season with salt and pepper.
Add the garlic and mixed herbs to the frying pan. Fry for 1 min.
steps.title: Add the Flavour

points: Stir the creme fraiche, chicken stock paste and water for the sauce (see pantry for amount) into the courgette pan.
Simmer, stirring occasionally, until the sauce has reduced and thickened slightly, 2-3 mins.
Once thickened, stir in the cheese until melted.
Remove from the heat and mix in the pesto.
steps.title: Sauce Things Up

points: Gently stir the cooked pasta into the sauce. Taste and season with salt and pepper if needed. Add a splash of water if it's a little too thick.
Share the pesto pasta between your bowls.
Sprinkle over the chilli flakes to finish (add less if you'd prefer things milder).
steps.title: Finish and Serve
